The tacos and burritos here were honestly some of the best I’ve ever had, and easily the best I’ve had in a long time. Every taco we tried was excellent, the ingredients tasted really fresh, everything was cooked perfectly, and there wasn’t a single dish that disappointed.

A Fun and Flavorful Taco Spot
Jun 2025 • Friends
Taco Del Sol is a great place to enjoy casual, flavorful Mexican food in a relaxed and friendly setting. The atmosphere is lively but comfortable, making it an easy choice whether you’re dining with friends, family, or just stopping by for a quick bite.

The food is fresh, well-prepared, and full of flavor. Tacos are generously filled, ingredients taste fresh, and the menu offers a good variety without feeling overwhelming. Everything feels straightforward, honest, and satisfying — exactly what you’d hope for from a taco spot.

Service is warm and welcoming. The staff is friendly, helpful with recommendations, and quick to make guests feel at ease. Orders come out promptly, and the overall experience feels smooth and enjoyable.

What stands out most is the relaxed vibe — no rush, no pressure, just good food and a pleasant place to unwind. It’s the kind of spot you’d happily return to after a day at the beach or a busy schedule.

Highly recommended if you’re craving tasty Mexican food with a laid-back atmosphere in Sai Gon

Nice night with Mexico cuisine
Dec 2025 • Family
Although this is my first time trying Mexican food, this restaurant is a wonderful place to enjoy both the food and the atmosphere. I’m really into the colorful decorations, the hype music and friendly people, they make the place feel lively and fun. The food genuinely surprised me with its taste. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and juicy. I’ll definitely come back soon to try the rest of the taco flavors. However, I do think that eating too much at once can feel overwhelming, as the flavors are quite rich and use strong-smelling ingredients. It’s better to take your time and really savor the food. As for the drinks, I’m not a cocktail connoisseur, but I found the cocktails a bit light and lacking a strong alcohol flavor. I personally prefer something bolder rather than a more soda-like drink.

A Fun Night Out at Taco Del Sol
Jan 2021
This is one of the really fun places in the city. Casual seating outside with bright cheerful and colorful decor, and a converted 1960's looking van as a tequila bar. Each time I have been there there has always been lots of people on the weekend, all enjoying the ambience and there is always a great buzz and atmosphere. I haven't been here for a while and I hear that their menu has had a lot added to it but I definitely loved the tacos with the chili con carne on them and avocado and salsa dips. They also make the best Margaritas in town, some with very novel flavours like the Red Dragon Fruit Margarita and the Passion Fruit Margarita with fresh chilis. But everyone of them is delicious and there are lots of other enticing sounding cocktails too which we have yet to try. Final mention must be made of the super friendly staff, and the extremely welcoming and lovely owner. It is honestly a delight to spend a casual evening at Taco Del Sol.

Gem of a find! Mexican street food under the bridge just outside Phu My Hung
Apr 2021 • Couples
What a chill spot where you can enjoy Mexican street food in an entirely open yet peaceful corner under the bridge. Low stools, oil barrel tables and hanging lights with cheeky paintings of abuelitas against a bright welcoming orange backdrop and VW-van-converted-to-standing-bar completed the feels of a dream Mexicana backyard resto. We almost can't find it since it's tucked away under this quiet bridge at night. Turns out, it's just 200 metres from Infiniti@Riviera Point, kinda before Docklands. 

Though small, it has many of the comfort Mexicano street foods like Tacos (all 12 flavours of them!), Nachos, Ceviches, etc but what surprised us the most was that they nailed the sauces --- Holy Trinity (Guacomole, Garlic Sour Cream, Chilli Con Carne) is a must-try. Portions of the tacos ain't big (you can finish one in 3 or 4 mouths) but that means you get to try more flavours! Hanabero salsa spicy fried chicken packs a punch, while Carne Asada beef with salsa verde and guac was uniquely refreshing. Nachos seemed to be house-made and freshly grilled! Octopus and shrimp dishes were alright, I'd prefer them if they were chunkier/ grilled more as their taste and thinly-sliced texture were kinda overpowered by the sauces.

Numerous cocktails, sides, drinks and enticing desserts to choose from too. Next time!
